title: Understanding Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
text: A bootstrap confidence interval is constructed using the percentiles of the bootstrap distribution. In this case, the $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles are given.

title: Percentiles in Bootstrap
text: The $$2.5th$$ percentile is the lower bound and the $$97.5th$$ percentile is the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval.

title: Identify the Correct Interval
